title: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
overview:
Rain of Arrows levels the character. Switch to Lightning Arrow on an elemental bow and use the final two loadouts to progress your mapper.

Build reference by Firkz Gaming. Original guide: https://pobarchives.com/build/bkVLJWMg
Original PoB: https://pobb.in/7ogW_TFuoV2D

Campaign items illustrate equipment progression. Use linked campaign drops you can equip. Some utility groups in campaign sets become available in later acts. Check gem requirements and combat assumptions before purchasing gear. Set the character level when you switch loadouts.

stages.title: Act 1 · Caustic Arrow
stages.goal: Use Caustic Arrow and Shrapnel Ballista.
stages.priority: Find a faster bow and a usable linked setup.

stages.title: Acts 2–3 · Rain of Arrows
stages.priority: Keep updating your bow. Add Herald of Ice and use Sniper’s Mark on bosses.

stages.title: Acts 5–6 · Prepare the bow swap
stages.goal: Continue Rain of Arrows while assembling the elemental bow setup.

stages.title: Atlas · Lightning Arrow
stages.goal: Clear with Lightning Arrow and use Storm Rain where appropriate for single target.
stages.priority: Upgrade the bow and cap resistances.
stages.swap: Switch once you have a well-linked elemental bow setup.

stages.title: Early red maps
stages.goal: Improve the elemental bow and quiver.
stages.priority: Balance accuracy, elemental damage, life and resistances.

stages.title: Mapping setup
stages.goal: Use the final mapper for clear.
stages.priority: Treat the auras and defensive affixes in this set as a package.
stages.budget: Stick with ordinary Lightning Arrow if the transfigured alternative is expensive.
